versions.description: OpenObserve (AGPL-3.0, referenced, never shipped) as the observability backend (logs, metrics, traces) of a Norca cluster: a single node on a host volume (SQLite) or a cluster with router, ingester, querier, compactor and alertmanager groups (PostgreSQL, NATS, RustFS), TLS with Norca's workload certificates, root user from the built-in secret store, an ingest service account for the collectors.
